_note: End-of-season result. Endings are tried in order; the first whose bars are all met wins, and the last one (no bars) catches the rest. A bar left out is open. Accuracy is the mean weighted accuracy over the days played (0 to 1), integrity the mean integrity (0 to the max in balance.json scoring.integrity.start), failed_days the shifts the line gave up on. Reason text can use {accuracy}, {min_accuracy}, {integrity}, {min_integrity}, {max_integrity}, {failed_days} and {max_failed_days}. integrity_story is the day report's line explaining today's integrity ({points} is signed). For the evaluation screen, each ending also has: stamp and stamp_note (the rubber stamp), look (the screen's colors: kept, probation or not_renewed), lorna_expression (a portrait_parts.json expression), rank (keep it in step with the title and order) and verdict (Lorna's line, ceb and en). In screen, intro can use {served} and {days}, bars_for can use {title}.

kept.title: Kept the post
kept.rank: This is the best of three endings: Kept the post.

verdict.ceb: Maayo kaayo ang imong trabaho karong enrollment. Imo gihapon ang Window 3 sunod semester.
verdict.en: You did very well this enrollment. Window 3 is still yours next semester.

probation.title: On probation
probation.rank: This is the middle of three endings: On probation.

verdict.ceb: Pwede na, pero daghan pa ta'g ayuhon. Sunod semester, bantayan tika.
verdict.en: It'll do, but we still have a lot to fix. Next semester, I'm keeping an eye on you.

not_renewed.title: Not renewed
not_renewed.rank: This is the worst of three endings: Not renewed.

verdict.ceb: Pasensya, pero kinahanglan namo og laing SA sa Window 3 sunod semester. Salamat gihapon sa kakugi.
verdict.en: I'm sorry, but we need someone else at Window 3 next semester. Thank you for your hard work, though.

screen.heading: Student Assistant evaluation
screen.intro: Enrollment season is over. You served {served} students across {days} days.
screen.failed_days: Shifts the line gave up on
screen.endings_note: Accuracy, integrity and lost shifts decide which one you get.

_regulars_note: What happened to each regular (events.json id) by how their visits went. Each day they came is one visit, right only if every call on them that day was right: good (every visit right), mixed (at least as many right visits as botched ones), bad (more botched visits than right ones) or missed (never reached the window). regular_default covers a regular with no lines yet; {name} is their first name and {number} their queue number. regular_expressions sets their portrait's face for each outcome.

jericho_112.good: Jericho got every subject he camped out for. He's graduating on time, and he still owes you banana cue.
jericho_112.mixed: Jericho got most of his subjects, but one fell through. He's taking it over the summer.
jericho_112.bad: Jericho's load fell apart by the end of adjustment. He's graduating a semester late.
jericho_112.missed: Jericho never made it to your window. Someone at another window sorted out his load.

carlo_104.good: Carlo is enrolled, adviser's signature and all. He bought an ID lace so it never falls out on the 13C again.
carlo_104.mixed: Carlo got enrolled after a few extra trips. He finally bought an ID lace, then lost it, ID and all, on day 2 of classes.
carlo_104.bad: Carlo spent the first week of classes still chasing his adviser's signature. His ID is still somewhere on the 13C jeepney.
carlo_104.missed: Carlo never made it to your window. He got sorted at Window 2. ID found, lace still pending.

mae_118.good: Mae kept her full load and her scholarship. Her color-coded slips are now the department's template.
mae_118.mixed: Mae kept her scholarship, barely. She added a new color to her slips: "double-check the SA."
mae_118.bad: Mae dropped below her maintaining load. She's appealing to keep her scholarship.
mae_118.missed: Mae never made it to your window. She got her load sorted at Window 2.

regular_default.good: #{number} {name} got everything sorted, thanks to you.
regular_default.mixed: #{number} {name} got there in the end, after a few extra trips.
regular_default.bad: #{number} {name} is still sorting out their enrollment.
regular_default.missed: #{number} {name} never made it to your window.

reasons.accuracy_ok: You scored {accuracy}% on your calls, with hard calls counting extra. The bar was {min_accuracy}%.
reasons.accuracy_low: You scored {accuracy}% on your calls, with hard calls counting extra. That's under the bar of {min_accuracy}%.
reasons.integrity_ok: Integrity {integrity} out of {max_integrity}. The bar was {min_integrity}.
reasons.integrity_low: Integrity {integrity} out of {max_integrity}, under the bar of {min_integrity}. Favors and false alarms cost you.
reasons.failed_days_ok: Shifts the line gave up on: {failed_days}. Allowed: {max_failed_days}.
reasons.failed_days_low: Shifts the line gave up on: {failed_days}. Allowed: {max_failed_days}.
